This Backyard Comes with Its Own Creek Access 😍 | Central Texas Dream Home #luxuryhomes 

🌳 Private Nolan Creek Access – Backyard Bliss at This Central Texas Retreat 🌊

Imagine having your own private access to Nolan Creek—right in your backyard! Whether you love kayaking, fishing, or just relaxing by the water, this property offers a rare chance to enjoy natural beauty and peaceful seclusion every single day.

Located between Fort Hood and Belton, this custom 3-bed, 3.5-bath home features:
✅ A fully renovated 3,000 sq ft layout
✅ Open-concept kitchen with granite counters
✅ A dreamy sunroom/office + a bonus “Treehouse” with 360° views
✅ A sparkling canning kitchen for the homesteader at heart
✅ RV hook-ups, a huge shop, and that forested backyard where deer graze daily

If you're looking for space, nature, and the ultimate Texas lifestyle retreat, this home is it. And trust us… Nolan Creek in your backyard? It doesn't get better than that.
